title: Fall Open House 2026
summary: Spend a day on the Grand Lakes campus. Tour the residence halls, sit in on a class, and meet faculty from all eight colleges.
body: Open House is the fullest day we run. Campus tours leave Hollis Quad every twenty minutes, academic departments hold drop-in sessions through the morning, and the afternoon is given over to the things prospective students actually ask about: housing, dining, advising, and what a first semester really looks like. Financial aid counselors are available all day without an appointment.

title: Inside the School of AI Studies
summary: An online preview of the School of AI Studies ahead of its December opening, with the founding faculty.
body: The School of AI Studies opens in December 2026. This hour covers what the first cohort will study, how the degree is structured across undergraduate and master's tracks, and how applicants are assessed. Founding faculty take questions for the second half. A recording is sent to everyone who registers, whether or not you attend live.

title: Lakeside Campus Tour
summary: A ninety-minute walking tour of the lakeside half of campus, led by current students.
body: Tours run rain or shine and cover the residence halls, the Marlow Library, the science quad and the shoreline research station. Groups are capped at fifteen so there is room to ask questions. Wear shoes you can walk in; the route is just over two miles and includes an unpaved stretch along the water.

title: Early Action Application Deadline
summary: The last day to submit an Early Action application for entry in Fall 2027.
body: Early Action is non-binding: you hear from us in January and have until May to decide. Applications must be submitted by 11:59 PM Eastern. Supporting materials — transcripts, recommendations, test scores if you are sending them — may arrive up to a week later without affecting your decision round.

title: Financial Aid and Scholarships Workshop
summary: A working session for families on aid forms, deadlines and how Grand Lakes builds an award.
body: Bring your questions and, if you have them, your tax documents. The first hour walks through the aid forms line by line. The second is open advising, where counselors look at individual situations. Families who cannot attend in person can join online; the link goes out the morning of the session.

title: Admitted Students Day
summary: For students admitted for Fall 2027 and their families: meet your college, your advisors and your future classmates.
body: The day is organised by college, so you spend most of it with the faculty and students you would actually be joining. Residence halls are open to walk through, the dining halls serve a normal weekday menu rather than a special one, and advisors run first-semester planning sessions in the afternoon.
